g.text: Four new questions, including signed changes in unemployment and immigration.
Here, shared party affiliation was disclosed and partisan symbols were shown; final answers follow two revisions.
Becker, Porter & Centola (2019) | doi.org/10.1073/pnas.1817195116 | Original author release
Panel estimate = arithmetic mean; errors divided by each question's true value, retaining its sign and decimals.
Author-flagged extreme rows are excluded; uncertainty resamples intact groups within party.
Every facet uses its own initial reference. Dashed = before feedback; solid = after revision.
k counts reports sampled from existing groups. It is not the number of participants needed to run the social experiment.
